content.title: 'The Boys' Season 5 Release Schedule: When Do New Episodes Come Out?
content.text: Chace Crawford, Antony Starr and Nathan Mitchell in 'The Boys'. Credit : Jasper Savage/Prime Video NEED TO KNOW The fifth and final season of The Boys premieres on April 8Season 5 will consist of 8 episodesThe Prime Video series stars Antony Starr, Jack Quaid and Karl Urban The final season of The Boys is here. Created by Eric Kripke, The Boys is a dark, violent superhero satire set in a world where superpowered people — known as “Supes” — are celebrities controlled by the powerful corporation Vought International. While the public sees them as heroes, many are corrupt, reckless and dangerous behind the scenes. In June 2024, Kripke announced that season 5 would mark the end of the Prime Video series. "Always my plan, I just had to be cagey till I got the final OK from Vought. Thrilled to bring the story to a gory, epic, moist climax," he wrote on X, nodding to the evil corporation at the center of his series. Season 5 will revolve around an all-out conflict between Homelander (Antony Starr), who has seized unprecedented power and pushed the world toward authoritarian rule, and Billy Butcher (Karl Urban), who becomes increasingly ruthless in his mission to destroy all Supes. Here's everything to know about The Boys season 5 episode release schedule. When does The Boys season 5 premiere? Valorie Curry and Colby Minifie in 'The Boys'. Jasper Savage/Prime Video The first two episodes of The Boys season 5 will premiere on April 8. How many episodes are in The Boys season 5? Karl Urban in 'The Boys'. Jasper Savage/Prime Video Following the pattern of the first four seasons, The Boys season 5 will feature eight episodes. While speaking to Collider in March 2025, Starr said he felt it was the right time for The Boys to come to an end. "It’s strange because as much as I love the show, I don't like seeing things outstay their welcome, so I'm kind of glad we're finishing at five, and that's it," he shared. "I love the show and the characters, so it's a bittersweet moment." Starr went on to tease the series finale, saying, "I think fans are going to be either surprised or shocked, depending on their nervous system, but very, very entertained." What is the The Boys season 5 episode release schedule? Erin Moriarty and Laz Alonso in 'The Boys'. Jasper Savage/Prime Video The Boys will return for its fifth and final season on April 8, and new episodes will debut weekly on Wednesdays. The season finale is scheduled for May 20. Jensen Ackles and Antony Starr in 'The Boys'. Jasper Savage/Prime Video The Boys will air new episodes on Wednesdays at 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET on Prime Video. Where can I watch The Boys season 5? Karen Fukuhara and Tomer Capone in 'The Boys'. Jasper Savage/Prime Video Season 5 of The Boys will be exclusively available to watch on Prime Video.
